enhance_ernie_image_prompt: enhance an input prompt for ErnieImage using a Ministral3 causal language model with configurable temperature and top_p
encode_ernie_image_prompts: encode prompts into variable-length hidden states using Mistral3Model for ErnieImage transformer
run_ernie_image_prompt_enhancer: run the ErnieImagePromptEnhancerStep to rewrite prompts via a causal language model within a modular pipeline
run_ernie_image_text_encoder: run the ErnieImageTextEncoderStep to produce prompt and negative prompt embeddings for classifier-free guidance
configure_ernie_image_guidance: configure classifier-free guidance with a guidance scale of 4.0 for ErnieImage text encoding
